notes:
v0.3.18: expanded dirty hybrid morph library. These are render-construction recipes, not semantic style cases.
v0.3.22: supports useMacros and slot-level macro expansion through vfx_slot_macros.json.
v0.3.23 adds foundation stack/light/sound/actor-placeholder recipes and macro layer cues.
v0.3.24: quality/LOD recipes use minQuality gates so Low keeps readable VFX while High/Ultra adds expensive layered polish.
v0.3.25: RenderQuality is always Full. Quality/LOD gates are deprecated as design axes; recipes now support importance/visualCost/signatureWeight and item-driven effectMagnitude.
v0.3.32: mundane_duplicate recipes give same low-tier parent fusions a restrained VFX path; heavy VFX remains available for rare/high-novelty items.
